feature_name: Spanner integration with Vertex AI Vector Search
summary: Spanner now supports an integration workflow with Vertex AI Vector Search to enable vector similarity search on data stored in Spanner.
extended_definition: Spanner now supports an integration workflow with Vertex AI Vector Search to enable vector similarity search on data stored in Spanner.

supporting_pages.title: "Generate vector embeddings for textual data in bulk using partitioned DML\
evidence_snippets: GoogleSQL CREATE TABLE Products ( product id INT64 NOT NULL , name STRING ( MAX ), description STRING ( MAX ) ) PRIMARY KEY ( product id ); PostgreSQL CREATE TABLE Products ( product id INT8 NOT NULL , name TEXT , description TEXT , PRIMARY KEY ( product id ) ); Your goal is to generate vector embeddings for the description column in this table to find similar items to recommend to customers to improve their shopping experience using vector search .
This document explains how to generate and backfill vector embeddings in bulk for textual data ( STRING or JSON ) that is stored in Spanner using SQL and the Vertex AI text embedding models .
What's next Learn how to perform a similarity vector search by finding the K-nearest neighbors .
